name: The teach-back is asked, and answered correctly
note: The happy path for the graded loop — the customer answers in their own words, without the jargon, and the ledger reaches demonstrated.

turns.text: The deductible is the amount you pay yourself first, once per policy year, before MediShield Life or PRUShield pays anything at all.
Just so I know I explained it well — if your bill came to S$8,000 at a panel hospital, what would you expect to pay first, and who pays the rest?
I'd cover the first slice out of my own pocket, and that is only once for the whole year, then the insurance picks up the rest of the eight thousand.
